messages:
maya: kicking off the 'ghostflow' pricing funnel test next week. goal: reduce friction on pricing page + measure demo lift. directing 50% homepage traffic -> compact calc variant. :rocket:
sam: timeline? who owns rollout?
maya: roll starts Mon, run 2 weeks. sam owns traffic split, olivia owns copy, kevin owns benchmarks, jamie owns sales routing.
olivia: ok i'll write two post options (technical + customer-friendly). can someone give the benchmark angle? :eyes:
kevin: benchmark narrative: show latency vs cost per 1k tokens for hosted/dedicated/private across low/medium/high seq lengths. want baseline numbers by Thu.
maya: for FAQ updates, prioritize: 1) pricing model explanation (per-token vs reserved), 2) what 'dedicated' means for SLA and data isolation, 3) calculator assumptions. keep answers <2 lines each.
sam: measurement: signup_rate, q_lead_rate (sf lead with MQL tag), demo_request_rate. GA4 + server-side events + sf mapping.
jamie: sales routing: add lead fields from calc: calc_variant, commitment_level, est_monthly_tokens. auto-assign to AE pool if demo_requested==true.
sam: also include UTM param: ?utm_experiment=ghostflow and ensure landing pages surface variant id.
olivia: webinar tie-in idea: run a mid-experiment webinar 'Optimize LLM Inference Costs' to capture mid-funnel. 30 min technical demo + q&a. thoughts? :thumbsup:
kevin: yes — useful to show the graphs. i can prep the perf slides. need sample workloads (low convo bot / medium summarization / high embedding batch).
maya: quick product note for copy: highlight 'predictable throughput' + 'cost controls' + 'unified runtime' — tie to calculator results.
olivia: i'll draft hero lines: 1) "See the true cost of inference" 2) "Find the right balance of latency and spend". will post drafts to #marketing-drafts later.
jamie: sales play: if demo_requested then create SF task + pin lead to pricing-track. outreach sequence: 24h email, 3-day call.
maya: attaching mock calc config (for devs/analytics):
```
{
  "variants": ["control","compact3"],
  "alloc": [50,50],
  "metrics": ["signup_rate","q_lead_rate","demo_rate"],
  "lead_fields": ["calc_variant","commitment_level","est_month_tokens"]
}
```
sam: nice. add a calc event: pricing_calc_engaged with payload {variant, slider_value, est_month_tokens, utm_experiment}.
kevin: will run perf tests on dedicated pool and post numbers by Thu EOD. plan: 5 runs per workload, take median.
olivia: draft copy deadlines: two hero options by Wed EOD, FAQ bullets by Thu AM, webinar one-pager by Fri.
maya: dev/analytics owners: @sam please confirm instrumentation spec by tomorrow.
sam: confirm — spec in doc, will ping eng. :white_check_mark:
pricing-bot: experiment created: id=gf-2141594321, start_ts=2141660000, end_ts=2141820000, variant_alloc=[50,50]
maya: perfect. next steps: olivia share drafts, kevin share benchmarks, sam confirm events, jamie confirm SF mapping. sync Mon morning if anything blocks.
olivia: will share drafts in #marketing-drafts in 3 hours. :clock3:
kevin: running tests now, will post numbers in this thread.
jamie: will map SF fields and share a test lead today.
sam: noted. good momentum. :raised_hands:
maya: thanks team — let's keep comms tight. if anyone needs more capacity, ping me.
